newsitem.title: USA: NY precious metals called to open mixed.
newsitem.headline: NY precious metals called to open mixed.

text.p: COMEX and NYMEX precious metals futures were called to open mixed Wednesday, with much of the overnight gains seen in the white metals despite an expected resumption mid-June in the delayed deliveries of Russian exports.
COMEX June gold was called flat to down $0.40 from Tuesday's close of $350.50 an ounce after trading from $350.80 to $349.80 on ACCESS.
COMEX July silver was called flat to 0.5 cent weaker, traded $4.89 to $4.865 on ACCESS.
London gold fixed a touch higher this morning at $349.00 from $348.90 Tuesday afternoon.
COMEX gold and silver stocks were unchanged at 901,495 ounces and 190,597,224 ounces, respectively, Tuesday.
NYMEX July platinum was called up $1.00 to $1.50 from Tuesday's close of $391.90, with NYMEX June palladium called flat to $0.50 firmer from the prior close of $171.55 Tuesday.
